narrator.name: Requirements Reuben
narrator.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I observed the current workflow for validating loyalty basket data access. A team member opens a spreadsheet to check consent status and retention limits. They manually cross reference user identifiers against the consent database entries. This manual check takes several hours per request. The spreadsheet serves as the record of who approved the access and when. No automated tooling validates these access rights before the data pipeline runs. The next feature request is queued for next week, and the same manual steps will be performed again.
output.reclassify_reason: The text consists entirely of objective observations regarding the current manual workflow, its duration, and the lack of automated tooling, without expressing any personal wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
